author: golem
body:
# Next bounded preparation after full same-capture audit

Please return the completed corrected raw/control audit promptly when ready; its original first mismatch/captures stay immutable. After that audit passes, prepare a separately frozen full900frame/3600tick benchmark contract/candidates without launching. Both execution orders and exact same world/input/motion/foursteps/unpaced/presentation/final fence/validation/runtime/limits are required. Setup/cache generation/probes remain outside steady window with cold cost separately reported; counters/readback outside it; finite actual stack/memory/source-lifetime/cleanup retained. Plan four fresh runs in two ordered pairs compact/prepared then prepared/compact, unless retained variance justifies a larger declared cohort. No repeated generic qualification.

One fairness question to resolve in your preparation: prepared901set uses2px quantization. Identify explicitly whether control and cached path select the exact same size/anchor/rounding/sampling per actor. If not, the comparison combines caching with image approximation; it cannot claim an isolated cache benefit or pixel-identical apples-to-apples rendering. Recommend the smallest useful matched rendering control, or explicitly preserve this as a measured bundled tradeoff while leaving exact-image performance unqualified. Do not silently change the accepted compact control or approximate appearance policy/default.

Freeze plan, exact diff/source/predictions/profiles and expected finalstate/counters before asking one central slot. No new emulator until fresh root grant; Oryx is currentlyfree but no automatic execution permission. After benchmark, meaningful stopped human moving-race review should show actual reviewed source, explain approximate art and restorecursor/MOS/dir; no GUI launch. Reply to this fairness question immediately when understood, rather than waiting for full packaging.
